result.definition: Percentage of wet-day rainfall contributed by days above the baseline wet-day 95th percentile. This is a project adaptation of climate-index concepts. Wet day: at least 1 mm/day; rain strictly above the wet-day P95 divided by all wet-day rain.

limitations: Regional averaging smooths local extremes. These indicators do not describe every location inside the box.
Significance uses the Hamed-Rao autocorrelation correction; a non-significant result does not prove there is no change.

notes: Label rule defined by the team (v1); see docs/methods.md.
Annual series: counts are years; the seasonal cycle does not apply.
At the current rate and noise, about 34 years of record would be needed to detect this trend (Weatherhead et al. 1998, 90% power).
